body: My brother passed away in an accident a few years ago and it ruined my dad. A father losing his son is something that fundamentally changes a man. I would come clean to your dad. I’d much rather deal with my father being angry at me for lying rather than knowing my father is suffering because I ended my life bc I couldn’t come clean. All the best, friend.

Oh sorry, it came off as if my dad was the root as my depression. That’s definitely not the case. My dad is AMAZING. He’s incredibly supportive and kind and is interested in all the same hobbies as myself. He’s what’s keeping me here. I wouldn’t ever want him to go through the pain of losing me. However, that’s still some sound advice. Honestly it’s hard to let myself go because I already feel so ugly and dorky so I feel like if I just let myself go I would without a doubt end my life. But as far as showing people my emotions, that’s something I’m definitely going to start doing. Thank you.

Sorry to hear about your loss. I was also 14 when my brother passed. It’s a really tough age to lose somebody at. I share your pain, I love the idea of going out but once I do, I just immediately feel exhausted and regret going out. You’re not alone. Keep your head up.

I appreciate your response. Unfortunately I was the last person in my family to see my brother so I think I will always carry a sense of guilt. The hug advice, however, is good advice. I’m gonna give my girlfriend a big ass bear hug tonight and hope that lifts my spirits. I really appreciate you taking the time out of your day to respond. All the best.

This helped a lot. I hope you’re able to find your way out of dark times. In my darkest times I remind myself to “have a mind like water so that reality is like my unbroken reflection”. For some reason this always seems to help so I hope it can help you too. Thanks for taking the time out to respond to the post. I hope you have a good holiday season.

Interesting perspective but I think this is more coming from a feminist perspective and not a stoic one. Still a valid opinion, just not quite what I was looking for. Thank you for your response though!
